identityReview: Matched He Xiaopeng / Xiaopeng He / 何小鹏 through official management biography and SEC filings. Not Hongdi Brian Gu (vice chairman and co-president), Yu Yongfu (UC group leader in 2014 announcement) or other XPeng co-founders. Birth year 1977 and Chinese identity supported by Wikipedia; exact birthday omitted. Wikipedia has a conflict-of-interest notice and is used narrowly for identity, not as primary career evidence.
lifeStatusEvidence: November 16, 2026 SEC-filed quarterly release quotes He as chairman and CEO discussing growth, demonstration approval and future robot production; accompanying 6-K is signed in that capacity. Current management biography confirms roles.

sourceReview.scope: Education, UC founding and product role, Alibaba transition, XPeng management appointment, both listings, investment closing and current results/forecasts.
corrections: Current official biography confirms July 1999 bachelor in computer science at South China University of Technology. Senior economist qualification from January 2020 is not a postgraduate academic degree; omitted rather than mislabeled.

UC co-founded in 2004; current biography specifies president of product from January 2005 to June 2014. Older draft registration uses a broader 2004–2014 production presidency; prefer updated specific biography.

June 11, 2014 Alibaba release concerns remaining UC equity after prior investments and approximately 66% economic interest. Its named new UC mobile business group leader is Yu Yongfu. He subsequently served in several Alibaba roles during June 2014–August 2017; do not assign all titles from acquisition day or claim him sole seller.

2020 draft registration specifically dates XPeng chairman and CEO tenure to August 2017. This is an executive appointment, not company founding. Official co-founder status is retained without claiming he alone established the car company then.

2021 Form 20-F item 9 verifies NYSE ADS listing August 27, 2020 and HK ordinary-share listing July 7, 2021. NYSE trading, IPO closing and Hong Kong dual-primary listing are distinct; no secondary-listing mislabel.

December 6, 2023 release confirms Volkswagen-related subscription closed: 94,079,255 Class A shares, approximately 4.99% immediately after issue, not a perpetual current percentage. July 26 agreement announcement is separate; board observer is non-voting, not acquisition of company control.
November 16, 2026 release is unaudited Q3 results and still reports net loss. Management growth language is attributed; no claim of net profitability from gross margin or deliveries.

L4 demonstration-operation approval is a specific claim in management quotation, not universal permission for all consumer cars to drive without supervision. Robot year-end production milestone is forward-looking as of cutoff. No future AI Day presentation or completed mass production asserted.
Technology and manufacturing contributions are attributed to teams and partners, not He as sole inventor. Market value, financing and personal income are not equated.
sourceReview.limits: AI authored and reviewed, not human/native-language certified. No independent vehicle safety testing, regulatory permit audit or full financial audit. Company forecasts are not verified achievements.
